title: Distribution of Relaxation Times Through the Lens of Distribution Theory
authors: Baptiste Py, Fei Wang, Jiapeng Liu, Xingyang Wang, Zilong Wang, Phillip M Wu, Maw-Kuen Wu, John Wang and Francesco Ciucci
abstract: The distribution of relaxation times (DRT) model is widely used to deconvolve <mark>electrochemical impedance</mark> spectra into timescale distributions. However, standard DRT formulations assume integrable impedance. This condition is violated by electrochemical systems with blocking boundaries where diffusion or charge accumulation causes the low-frequency response to diverge. We formulate DRT inversion in the space of tempered distributions and derive a distributional Fuoss–Kirkwood boundary-value relation in , under explicit analyticity, growth, and boundary-value assumptions on the strip continuation…
